method: Compare predecessor->successor structure across heterogeneous JSON; reserve causal status for future relation-specific rewiring.

connections.name: PREDECESSOR_DETERMINES_SUCCESSOR_ADMISSIBILITY
connections.observation: Several records make the next admissible action depend on complete prior state/history rather than on the current record alone.
evidence: Sequential witness defines the bound relative to complete pre-target history F_{i-1}.
Temporal rollback hardening rejects locally valid stale prefixes unless an external freshness root exists.
Proof-carrying experimental flow separates exposure integrity from outcome claims before promotion.
Animal-welfare protocol uses residual uncertainty to determine whether a live step remains necessary.
Replicated Man governance separates prior provenance disclosure from the later identity-holder choice.
connections.claim_ceiling: Structural recurrence only; no causal claim yet.

connections.name: HISTORY_IS_NOT_DECORATION
connections.observation: Historical records are operational inputs that constrain later verification, promotion, or action.
connections.claim_ceiling: The history-carrier role is evidenced; independence from common authoring remains untested.

connections.name: STALE_STATE_CAN_REMAIN_AUTHENTIC_BUT_BECOME_INADMISSIBLE
connections.observation: A state may remain internally valid/authentic while becoming invalid for the next decision because freshness/continuity changed.
connections.evidence: Temporal rollback hardening explicitly separates authenticity from freshness and requires an external freshness root.
connections.importance: This distinguishes content validity from temporal eligibility.

connections.name: REPLAY_IS_A_CONTROL_FOR_TEMPORAL_DEPENDENCE
connections.observation: Rollback/replay provides a natural counterfactual: restore a predecessor and test whether the same successor gate/state is recovered.
connections.testable_prediction: If the proposed temporal edge is meaningful, controlled predecessor rewiring should reduce the original successor relation while preserving schema-level statistics.

connections.name: MARGINAL_EQUIVALENCE_DOES_NOT_IMPLY_HISTORY_EQUIVALENCE
connections.observation: Two systems can share the same per-trial or per-field marginals while differing in conditional dependence on prior history.
connections.evidence: Sequential witness counterexample explicitly shows fair marginals can coexist with perfect adaptive copying after prior observation.
connections.claim_ceiling: This is a methodological warning, not a claim that the registry's unrelated domains share a common generator.

edge_survival_target.rewiring_rule: Permute predecessor-successor assignments while preserving node count, field counts, value marginals, and local schema statistics as far as feasible.

important_negative_control: Do not count repeated version chains or direct parent-child lineage as independent cross-domain evidence; provenance recurrence must be separated from operator recurrence.
next_gate: Execute predecessor-successor rewiring on matched records and report effect size plus null distribution before promoting any temporal connection.
